notes: Seven additional original school exercises, not board papers or newly authored prompts: four matching sets and three rearranging sets. Prompt/table page images checked at PDF 35,40,45,48,75; preceding paper headers visually checked at 33,38,44,46,73. Original spelling, grammar, capitalisation and punctuation retained; line wraps normalised. Suggested answers are assistant-prepared, not official keys.

Human rights on PDF35 retained once; repeated variants on 48/70 are not additional sets. Truthfulness is distinct from existing morality/punctuality sets. Sonargaon, democracy, Internet, patriotism, email, early rising, tree plantation, road accidents and other repeated themes are not counted again.

Water table retains source The another, but then, Their, Throw and stray comma in factories , throw; keys are literal source-fragment concatenations, not silently corrected prose. Truthfulness moral absolutes are source rhetoric, not a guarantee that every lie is exposed. Human-rights violations are attributed to source statements rather than a researched global survey.

Cyber-security table retains prevent exposure. This is a simplified language exercise, not a promise of complete protection. Passwords, antivirus and safe browsing reduce risks; none guarantee immunity. Two-factor authentication adds a layer rather than making all attacks impossible.

Farmer/animals narrative retains property (apparently intended properly) and not enough grown up. It does not establish that children or any age group are incapable of care. Washington beam episode is a traditional anecdote, not independently verified history; source retains America, batter and lam. Narrative orders are possible coherent readings, not unique official solutions.

Language Movement sequence places This day directly after February 21. Recognition follows protest; interpretive legacy sentences come last. No new dates added. This is one narrative set, not eight independent items.

Held Florence Nightingale Unseen on PDF103 after visual review: illness-for-years blank does not specify an endpoint; 53 requires assuming continuation from 1857 until death in 1910. No invented endpoint or silent question repair. It therefore contributes zero complete Unseen pairs. Also held Great Wall table75 absent ruler premise, Milton40 conflicting publication years, malformed student53 matching and repeated or unsafe stereotype/medical sets. Requested quotas remain unfinished.
